About Ume Intelligence

Ume Intelligence is a marketing science company solving complex commercial problems for multi-location restaurant brands. We build modern analytics and automation infrastructure, paired with hands-on digital operations that turn operational data into measurable revenue.

We operate as a lean, high-leverage team with no walls between engineering and operations. We look for people who run toward technology, automation, and data models rather than away from them, and who judge their work by business impact rather than activity.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with our two co-founders in the Founders’ Office.

This is a high-leverage generalist role. On a given day you might schedule five candidate interviews, reconcile last month’s expenses, file a state registration, pull an enriched list of 40 restaurant groups to prospect, and research a new vendor before lunch. You will take whole areas of work off the founders’ plates, run them reliably, and turn the repeatable parts into checklists, templates, and automations so they get easier every month.

You will see the whole company up close: hiring, finance, sales, marketing, and compliance. For the right person, the role grows with the company into building and leading business operations as an executive function.

Who This Role Is For (and Not For)

  • This role is for you if: You view no operational task as too small, but you never treat them as permanent manual chores—you treat them as systems to streamline, automate, and document. You take genuine pride in zero dropped balls, meticulous back-office execution, and returning hours of time to executive leadership.

  • This role is not for you if: You are looking for a purely advisory/strategy consulting seat, or conversely, a traditional executive assistant role centered around personal calendar coordination. This is hands-on operational infrastructure building across legal, finance, recruiting, and GTM.

What You’ll Own

  • Recruiting Coordination: Run our applicant pipeline end-to-end in our ATS: candidate communication, interview scheduling across time zones, scorecard hygiene, and follow-ups. Prepare offer paperwork and drive new hire onboarding and offboarding workflows.

  • Bookkeeping & Back-Office Finance: Categorize transactions, issue and chase customer invoices, coordinate bills and receipts, and prepare clean month-end closes for our external accounting firm.

  • Government & Compliance Paperwork: Track and prepare state and local filings, annual reports, registrations, business licenses, and tax notices. Coordinate directly with our registered agent, CPA, and payroll provider so nothing is ever late or non-compliant.

  • Remote Office & Vendor Management: Manage software subscriptions, seat provisioning, access permissions, hardware/equipment, and our virtual mailbox. Audit tools regularly, negotiate vendor contracts, and cut unused subscriptions.

  • GTM Research & Lead Enrichment: Research prospective multi-unit restaurant groups and regional enterprise brands. Build, enrich, and verify qualified lead directories, keep the CRM clean, and draft initial outreach templates for the founders.

  • Marketing Operations Support: Maintain campaign calendars, assemble client-facing and internal metrics reports from our data tools, schedule content, and keep digital brand assets organized.

  • Executive & Business Research: Investigate open-ended questions quickly and synthesize them into crisp 1-page briefs: a competitor’s product model, a market landscape, a regulatory filing nuance, or a vendor pricing benchmark.

  • Systematization & Automation: Document every workflow you touch into reusable runbooks, and proactively deploy modern AI and automation tools (Zapier/Make, prompt chains) to eliminate manual administration.

Your First 90 Days

  • Day 30: You fully own candidate scheduling and the month-end bookkeeping close. You maintain a living calendar of every recurring corporate filing, tax date, and subscription renewal, eliminating dropped balls across back-office operations.

  • Day 60: You own vendor and subscription management, and you have built our baseline restaurant prospecting directory (multi-unit operators across target regions) with verified decision-maker data.

  • Day 90: You have standardized an operational playbook: an end-to-end employee onboarding checklist, automated receipt-matching workflows, and routine operational reporting that runs without founder intervention. The founders spend measurably less time on administrative drag.

Our Operational Stack

  • Productivity & Workspace: Google Workspace, Notion / Markdown docs, Slack, Zoom

  • Finance & Compliance: QuickBooks Online / Xero, Gusto / Deel, Virtual Mailbox

  • Pipeline & Operations: Modern ATS (e.g., Ashby, Dover, Greenhouse), CRM / Prospecting tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)

  • Automation & AI: ChatGPT / Claude (daily research, data extraction, drafting), Zapier / Make

What You Bring

Experience & Background

  • 3 to 6 years of experience in business operations, a founder’s/CEO’s office, a high-ownership executive operational role, or early-stage startup operations.

  • Hands-on bookkeeping fluency with tools such as QuickBooks or Xero. You understand the fundamentals of reconciliations, invoicing, expense categorization, and cash management.

  • Full-cycle recruiting operations experience, from managing applicant pipelines to scheduling panels and preparing offer packets.

  • A degree in business, finance, economics, communications, or equivalent practical track record.

Core Competencies & Must-Haves

  • Extreme Reliability: When an operational item is on your plate, it gets done accurately on schedule without reminders. You surface bottlenecks early.

  • Judgment & Discretion: Absolute discretion and integrity handling confidential legal, payroll, financial, and executive communications.

  • AI & Tool Fluency: You don’t just use AI to write emails—you actively use LLMs and workflow automations to parse unstructured data, research edge cases, draft documentation, and systematically eliminate manual steps.

  • Written Clarity: Impeccable, clear, and concise written English. You can turn fragmented founder thoughts into a structured checklist, a one-page briefing doc, or a polished external email.

  • Autonomous Resourcefulness: You run to ground unfamiliar questions—whether a complex state registration rule, a vendor contract clause, or a restaurant group’s VP of Marketing—without needing a predefined roadmap.

Nice to Have

  • Practical knowledge of US corporate compliance (Delaware filings, California state registrations, payroll/tax compliance).

  • Background or strong familiarity with the food & beverage, hospitality, or multi-location retail sector.

  • Prior experience working in a fully distributed, asynchronous startup team.

Working Schedule & Rhythm

  • Structure: Full-time, flexible schedule.

  • Core Overlap: A consistent daily window of at least 2 to 3 hours overlapping with the founders between 7:00 AM and 11:00 AM US Pacific for daily syncs, real-time unblocking, and candidate coordination, with asynchronous flexibility for the remainder of your day.

How Performance Is Measured

  • Reliability: 100% on-time execution for compliance filings, billing, vendor payments, candidate touchpoints, and month-end closes.

  • Founder Leverage: Concrete reduction in executive hours spent on administrative overhead and operational friction.

  • Work Quality: High accuracy across the general ledger, compliance docs, and prospect research; minimal rework required.

  • Compounding Efficiency: Number of recurring processes converted into documented playbooks, templates, or software automations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Full-Time Compensation: Stable, competitive monthly base salary.

  • Meaningful Equity Participation: Stock option grant with real upside in a high-leverage US enterprise company.

  • Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid annual leave and public holidays.

  • Total Executive Transparency: Direct visibility into the entire operational, strategic, and financial machinery of an early-stage company.

  • Clear Career Trajectory: Opportunity to define and lead business operations as Ume expands.

Our Interview Process

  1. Introductory Screen (30 mins): High-level conversation covering your background, communication style, working rhythm, and scope alignment.

  2. Practical Work Trial (Take-home, ~60–90 mins): A realistic exercise mirroring a typical morning in the Founders’ Office (e.g., reconciling a messy expense ledger, answering an ambiguous vendor research prompt, and drafting a candidate coordination brief).

  3. Founders Deep Dive (45 mins): In-depth discussion on problem-solving, operational judgment, automation philosophy, and mutual team fit.

Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

As an Account Manager, your main objectives are to meet or exceed sales goals within a set of enterprise and mid-market accounts. Using a consultative approach you will own the full sales process, engage senior decision-makers in discussion, gain a deep understanding of their challenges, share previous success, bring industry knowledge to the table, and pitch and close-win relevant solutions from TechnologyAdvice’s suite of B2B marketing products and services. These include brand-to-demand activations, lead generation, advertising, StudioA content creation, and events.

While you are expected to be accountable for your own quota, you will receive exceptional support and collaboration from TechnologyAdvice’s senior leadership, client success and delivery teams, StudioA, Deal Desk, sales enablement, SDRs, and the wider business.

Location: Singapore

What you'll do

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan
  • Grow client accounts both in terms of their finite number, and their annual value
  • Prospect effectively, organizing your time, and deliver professional and memorable sales pitches to new prospects and existing contacts to achieve quota.
  • Create and execute key sales and business development strategies to increase pipe

Web Experimentation and Operations Associate

Location: Remote – Colombia

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (fixed term, full-time)
Industry: Technology & IT / Digital Marketing
Compensation: $2,167–$2,667 USD/month
Schedule: Full-time | Business hours (time zone to be confirmed with the client)
English Proficiency: C1 (Excellent spoken and written English)

About the Role

Our client is a global financial technology company that serves consumers, small businesses, and mid-market companies worldwide. The team this role supports works on web experiences for mid-market offerings that help growing businesses manage financial operations, payroll, payments, and marketing in one place.
This is a full-time, fixed-term contract role through December 14, 2027, supporting the repeatable parts of mid-market web work, including hub pages, CMS-related work, and related web operations.
This is a support role. The engagement lead sets priorities, writes hypotheses, and makes decisions. You will build, check, update, and draft from templates and clear instructions, and flag anything that is unclear. Work is reviewed before it ships. The role does not include deciding test results, signing off on launches or tests, making budget or vendor decisions, managing employees, or publishing without approval.
This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who is comfortable with experimentation setups, web QA, status tracking, and light automation, and who writes clear, short, accurate updates on time.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Clear, defined work with templates, instructions, and review before anything ships.
  • A mix of experimentation support, web operations, launch support, and light automation.
  • Hands-on experience with mid-market web work at a global financial technology company.
  • A support structure in which the engagement lead sets priorities and decisions, so you can focus on precise execution.

What You'll Do

Test and Offer Support (~45%)

  • Set up experiments and offers in the company's internal experimentation and campaign platforms, following approved specs.
  • QA each build in preview, across browsers and mobile, and log issues.
  • Fill in the readout template with results from the analytics team and the test tool. The engagement lead writes the conclusion.
  • Target one light test setup per month from month 3, growing over time.

Web Operations Hygiene and Launch Support (~40%)

  • Keep status and dates current each week in Quickbase, Jira, and Airtable, and keep the web project register updated.
  • Run UAT checklists on new and re-themed pages, log issues, and confirm fixes.
  • Draft launch announcements and change notes from templates for approval.

Light Automation (~15%)

  • Run and monitor existing scheduled reports, and flag failures.
  • Build small reports and automations on request using Claude and approved tools, with review.
  • Write a short note for each automation (what it does, what it reads, and who to ask).
Tools you will use include internal experimentation and campaign platforms, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Edge Delivery Services, Contentstack, Quickbase, Jira, Airtable, Slack, Google Workspace, and Claude.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics.
  • Strong attention to detail, and comfort following specs, templates, and checklists.
  • Experience with spreadsheets and ticketing or work-management tools (Jira, Airtable, or similar).
  • Clear, short, accurate, and on-time written updates.
  • Asks for help early when something is unclear, rather than waiting.
  • C1 English (excellent spoken and written English).
  • Based in Colombia, Mexico, or Chile, and able to work fully remotely in a full-time capacity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with A/B testing or personalization tools (Optimizely, Adobe Target, VWO, or similar).
  • Day-to-day use of Claude or another AI assistant.
  • Basic SQL or scripting.
  • Familiarity with Quickbase, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), or Contentstack.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:
  • Attention to detail and comfort following specs, templates, and checklists.
  • Clear, short, accurate, and on-time written communication.
  • Asking for help early when something is unclear, rather than waiting.
  • Hands-on experience with spreadsheets and ticketing or work-management tools.
  • Ability to work effectively in a support role, with work reviewed before it ships.
  • Relevant experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics (1-3 years).
  • C1 spoken and written English.
  • Availability to work full-time and remotely from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.

How Success Is Measured

  • Experiments and offers go live accurately and on schedule, with QA issues caught before they reach production.
  • Test readouts are complete on time, so the engagement lead can draw conclusions without missing inputs.
  • From month 3, light test setups are delivered at the agreed monthly pace and increase over time.
  • The team can rely on a current weekly view of status, dates, and the web project register.
  • New and re-themed pages complete UAT with issues resolved before launch.
  • Launch communications are ready for approval when needed, so releases are not delayed.
  • Scheduled reports stay reliable, failures are flagged quickly, and new automations are documented for handover.
  • The engagement lead can trust your written updates and early flags, with minimal rework.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote opportunity from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.
  • Competitive compensation: $2,167–$2,667 USD/month, depending on experience.
  • A defined, full-time contract through December 14, 2027, with clear scope and review before work ships.
  • A culture built on integrity, customer focus, inclusive collaboration, and continuous learning.

Important Notes

Applications may not be considered if candidates:
  • Are not based in Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.
  • Cannot work full-time in a fully remote arrangement.
  • Do not have 1-3 years of experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics.
  • Do not have C1 spoken and written English, or cannot deliver clear, short, accurate, on-time written updates.
  • Are not detail-oriented, or are not comfortable working from specs, templates, and checklists.

We are changing FINANCE to finance CHANGE!

At Climate First Bank, we’re redefining what banking can be. As a Florida Benefit Corporation and FDIC-insured commercial bank, we offer a full suite of personal and business services—including solar, residential, commercial, ESOP Banking, Structured Finance and SBA loans—all designed to power a better future. We’re proud to be a Certified B Corporation, a member of 1% for the Planet, and part of the Global Alliance for Banking on Values (GABV), reflecting our deep commitment to sustainability, transparency, and ethical banking.

With branches in St. Petersburg, Winter Park, Mount Dora, Downtown Orlando and a growing digital presence, we’re proving that banking can be a force for good. We don’t just support environmental and social causes—we’re built on them.

Under our Holding Company, Climate First Bancorp, we are also powered by OneEthos. OneEthos operates at the intersection of fintech and traditional banking to expand access to inclusive, values-driven financial services. Regulated by the Federal Reserve Bank, it equips Community Banks, Credit Unions, CDFIs, and Green Banks with ethical lending tools—especially in climate finance and solar lending.

Join the Movement

We’re seeking driven, mission-aligned individuals ready to make an impact. If you’re passionate about sustainability, thrive in a fast-paced, results driven environment, and want to be part of something bigger, you will feel right at home.

Our team is one of goal-setters, go-getters, problem solvers, thought leaders, and changemakers. We celebrate wins, tackle challenges head-on, and push boundaries. Fueled by purpose, we thrive where perseverance and passion turn ambitious goals into reality.

Thrive at Climate First Bank

At Climate First Bank, we’re investing in your future. We offer a comprehensive, people-first benefits package that supports your health, finances, and work-life balance. Please note that benefit eligibility varies by employment status and that benefits for part-time employees may differ from those listed below.

Compensation— In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for an annual bonus, incentives and equity. Actual compensation is based on industry salary ranges, internal salary structures, experience, skills and other job-related factors.

Generous Paid Time Off

  • 2–4 Weeks of Vacation based on officer level plus additional tenure-based time.

Protection & Peace of Mind

  • Voluntary Life, Accident & Critical Illness Coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free counseling, legal, and financial services.

What to Expect as the Talent Acquisition Generalist

The Talent Acquisition Generalist supports the full candidate lifecycle. This role combines recruiting coordination, reporting and process improvement. You will independently manage recurring activities, apply sound judgment, protect confidential information. You’ll partner with People leaders, hiring managers, employees, candidates, and banking teams to deliver an organized and consistent experience.

What You Will Contribute in This Role

  • People Attraction and Candidate Support - Coordinate candidate workflows from application through pre-employment, including interview scheduling, candidate communications, assessments, document collection, status tracking, and offer support. Maintain accurate records and identify delays or gaps that require escalation.
  • Candidate Pipelining and Applicant Management - Build and maintain active candidate pipelines for repeatable, high-volume requisitions.
  • New-Hire Bank Account Opening - Guide new hires through the account-opening process and complete assigned account-opening activities in accordance with Bank procedures. Validate required information and documentation, coordinate timely resolution of exceptions, protect customer and employee data, and help ensure accounts are available for the employee’s first direct deposit.
  • Reporting and Data Integrity - Prepare recurring and ad hoc recruiting and workforce reports. Review data for accuracy, reconcile discrepancies across systems, summarize trends, and provide leaders with clear information for operational decisions.
  • Process Improvement and Project Ownership - Lead assigned People Attraction projects from planning through completion. Evaluate workflows, recommend practical improvements, document procedures, test automations, and use Microsoft 365, the ATS, and related tools to improve service, controls, and efficiency.
  • Communication and Partnership - Maintain proactive communication with candidates, employees, hiring managers, People leaders, and internal partners. Prepare status updates, meeting materials, onboarding communications, and other documentation that keeps work moving and stakeholders informed.
  • Confidentiality and Risk Management - Exercise discretion with employee, candidate, payroll, and customer information. Follow established approval paths and internal controls, recognize issues that require escalation, and support audit, compliance, and regulatory requests.
  • Mission and Compliance - Champion the Bank’s commitment to environmental, social, economic, and racial justice. Complete required compliance and information security training and maintain working knowledge of policies and regulations relevant to the role, including BSA, AML, CIP, and OFAC requirements.

What You Will Leverage in This Role

  • Education and Experience - Two to four years of progressive experience in human resources, recruiting operations, People Operations, banking operations, or a comparable generalist role. A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related discipline is preferred.
  • Generalist Judgment - Ability to independently organize work, interpret established policies and procedures, resolve routine issues, recognize risk, make sound recommendations, and escalate appropriately. Comfortable balancing service, compliance, confidentiality, and business needs.
  • Banking and Account-Opening Readiness - Experience with customer onboarding, deposit operations, branch banking, or account opening is preferred. Ability to learn and consistently follow customer identification, documentation, privacy, and information security requirements is required.
  • Systems and Analytical Capability - Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience working in an HRIS, applicant tracking system, payroll platform, or other workflow technology. ADP Workforce Now and Greenhouse experience are preferred. Able to analyze data, identify discrepancies, and produce clear reports.
  • Project and Process Management - Ability to manage recurring deadlines and cross-functional projects, document procedures, maintain controls, and improve workflows without sacrificing accuracy or employee experience.
  • Communication and Relationship Building - Clear, tactful, and responsive communication across candidates, employees, managers, executives, and external partners. Ability to explain processes, set expectations, follow up on commitments, and handle sensitive matters with professionalism and empathy.
  • Organization and Accuracy - Attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and comfort managing competing priorities in a high-growth environment. Maintains accurate files, trackers, calendars, and system records.
  • Integrity and Teamwork - Consistently protect confidential information, follow through on commitments, contribute ideas, support teammates, and take ownership of outcomes.

How We Work Together at Climate First Bank

How we work is as important as what we do. Every team member is expected to deliver high-quality results on time, collaborate across functions, communicate clearly, and contribute to a mission-driven, high-performance culture. Responsibilities may shift as the organization grows, and success in this role requires adaptability, sound judgment, and a willingness to support priorities across the People team.

The Work Environment:

  • Work Location - Remote within the United States, working primarily Eastern Time hours. Occasional travel to Bank branches, company events, or working sessions may be required.
  • Physical Requirements - Regular use of a computer and sustained sitting or standing; frequent speaking, listening, typing, and attention to a monitor; and occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  • Employment and Banking Expectations - This position is subject to applicable Bank employment, confidentiality, information security, and compliance requirements. Employees should follow current Bank guidance regarding payroll delivery and employee banking relationships.

The Hiring Process:

Applications must be submitted through the official application link. Resumes sent via other channels may be delayed or bypassed. Processing times may vary. Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted by the hiring team.

Our process follows the Topgrading Methodology — we hire A-Players through a structured, transparent process that includes:

  • Cognitive and personality assessments
  • An application form spanning your full education and work history
  • 3 conversation stages with key team members- get to know us!
  • Credit and background checks conducted before the final interview
  • Final Step: Connect us with former mentors and managers of our choice for reference chats.

We do not offer visa sponsorship and will not pursue candidates without valid work authorization.

Job Title: Brand Launch & Optimization Manager (E-Commerce)

Job Overview

We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Brand Launch & Optimization Manager to oversee the successful onboarding and optimization of newly acquired brands across ecommerce marketplaces. This role is responsible for transforming basic product catalogs into profitable, high-performing online stores while identifying opportunities to improve existing brands when applicable.

The ideal candidate has strong experience with Amazon and Walmart marketplaces, inventory and business management systems, and excels at analyzing data to drive growth. You will take ownership of brands during their critical launch phase, implementing strategies that position them for long-term success before transitioning them to the ongoing management team.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Launch & Optimization

  • Manage newly acquired brands from onboarding through their initial growth phase
  • Transform basic product lists into fully optimized and market-ready online storefronts
  • Develop and execute launch strategies that improve profitability and brand value
  • Identify opportunities to optimize existing brands and enhance overall performance
  • Ensure brands are properly positioned for long-term success before handoff

Marketplace Management

  • Create, update, and optimize product listings on Amazon and Walmart
  • Improve product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, and backend attributes
  • Monitor listing health and resolve catalog issues promptly
  • Analyze competitor activity and identify growth opportunities

Inventory & Operations

  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment needs
  • Utilize inventory and business software to maintain accurate records and reporting
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend process improvements
  • Support cross-functional teams to ensure smooth brand execution

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Track sales performance, profitability, and key marketplace metrics
  • Build and maintain reports using Google Sheets
  • Analyze trends and provide recommendations for optimization
  • Present insights and progress updates to leadership

Project Management

  • Coordinate multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
  • Ensure timelines and deliverables are met
  • Document processes and facilitate smooth transitions to long-term account managers

Qualifications

  • Proven experience managing Amazon and Walmart marketplace accounts
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce operations and marketplace best practices
  • Experience launching, optimizing, or scaling ecommerce brands
  • Familiarity with inventory management and business software systems
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, including formulas and reporting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Ability to work independently and make data-driven decisions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Amazon Seller Central and Walmart Seller Center
  • Knowledge of inventory forecasting and demand planning
  • Experience with listing optimization and conversion strategies
  • Familiarity with ecommerce reporting tools and marketplace analytics

Required Software & Tools

  • Amazon Seller Central
  • Walmart Seller Center
  • Inventory & Business Management Software
  • Google Sheets

Employment Type

  • Full-Time - 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM EST

      <title>Celonis: Client Value Partner (CVP) - Utilities & Energy Industry</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US, Ohio
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2>
<p>We are seeking an established consulting leader—a current Big Four Director, Managing Director, or Partner-track Senior Manager—to spearhead our highest-stakes Energy &amp; Utilities engagements. In this executive-level role, you will serve as the principal strategic architect for our most valuable power, gas, and renewable energy accounts globally.</p>
<p>Leveraging the Celonis Process Intelligence platform, you will bridge the gap between macro energy sector strategies and modern cloud/AI execution models, moving clients from slide decks to realized operational value.<br><br></p>
<h2><strong>The Impact You’ll Make</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>1. C-Suite Advisory &amp; Value Architecture</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Peer-to-Peer Advisory:</strong> Partner directly with utility C-suite executives (CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Chief Sustainability Officers) to align macro pressures—decarbonization, grid modernization, and capital reallocation—with execution-level transformation roadmaps.</li>
<li><strong>Map Enterprise Digital Twins:</strong> Oversee the deployment of the Celonis Process Intelligence Graph to build systemic, end-to-end operational models of complex utility enterprises.</li>
<li><strong>Orchestrate $100M+ Business Cases:</strong> Direct the formulation of board-ready Celonis Value Assessments, delivering the economic justification, working capital improvements, and OPEX returns required to greenlight massive cloud and Edge AI investments.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>2. Transformation Leadership &amp; Ecosystem Governance</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Steer Enterprise Transformations:</strong> Serve as the executive sponsor for high-visibility, Celonis-driven operating model overhauls for Fortune 500 E&amp;U clients, guiding them from diagnostic discovery to closed-loop automation.</li>
<li><strong>Architect Celonis Centers of Excellence (CoEs):</strong> Design and establish corporate-wide CoEs, defining the target operating models, governance structures, and enablement frameworks needed to embed data-driven decision-making into client cultures.</li>
<li><strong>Untangle Systemic Friction:</strong> Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex operational leakages where siloed utility stacks (SAP S/4HANA, IBM Maximo, ADMS/SCADA) collide—specifically optimizing capital procurement, field services, and energy settlement invoicing.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>3. Commercial Growth &amp; Scaled Innovation</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>De-Risk High-Value Sales Cycles:</strong> Convert complex regulatory mandates (FERC, NERC) into automated, visual compliance audits within the Celonis platform, transforming abstract compliance risks into compelling business cases that accelerate C-suite sign-off.</li>
<li><strong>Commercialize Next-Gen "Process + AI" Use Cases:</strong> Direct the integration of industrial telemetry (SCADA, Edge IoT) into Celonis, translating complex data structures into high-margin, executive-ready offerings like real-time storm response and predictive asset failure.</li>
<li><strong>Productize Utility Value Plays:</strong> Codify repeatable client successes into scalable Celonis apps and action templates, establishing a library of industry-specific intellectual property that drives rapid time-to-value, net-new ARR, and account expansion.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Profile We Are Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Consulting Pedigree:</strong> 12+ years of progressive experience within a Big Four or elite management consulting firm, currently operating at the Director, Managing Director, or Partner level.</li>
<li><strong>E&amp;U Vertical Expertise:</strong> Deep, authoritative knowledge of the Energy &amp; Utilities sector (Grid Operations, Transmission &amp; Distribution, Generation, or Retail), with a track record of leading multi-million-dollar transformation programs.</li>
<li><strong>SaaS &amp; Process Intelligence Vision:</strong> Strong conceptual understanding of Process Mining paradigms. Experience with Celonis is highly advantageous, but a proven ability to leverage enterprise software to reshape business processes is required.</li>
<li><strong>Architectural Fluency:</strong> Comprehensive understanding of the modern enterprise stack (SAP, Oracle, Maximo) and emerging data/AI paradigms (Azure AI, LLMs). <em>Note: You do not need to write code or SQL queries, but you must possess the technical fluency to direct data scientists, engineers, and solution architects.</em></li>
<li><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong> Proven capability in client origination, relationship management, and driving account growth through value-based selling.</li>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Systems. An MBA from a top-tier business school is highly preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p>
<ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested">
<li><span>Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li>
<li><span>Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li>
<li><span>Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li>
<li><span>Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li>
<li><span>Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li>
<li><span>Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li>
<li><span>Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li>
<li><span>Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li>
<li><span>Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About Us:</strong></p>
<p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p>

And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.<strong><br></strong></p>

<p>Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/candidate-notices">Accessibility and Candidate Notices</a></p>
<p>By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/privacy-notice/">Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools</strong><br><br>We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.<br><br>The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.</p>
<p>Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/fraud-alert/">here</a>.</p></div>

      <title>Reddit: Analytics Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first">
<div class="p-rich_text_block">
<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div></div><p>We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.</p>
<p>Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.</li>
<li>Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data</li>
<li>Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.</li>
<li>Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines</li>
<li>Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems</li>
<li>Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability.</li>
<li>Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field</li>
<li>3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment.</li>
<li>Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.</li>
<li>Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.</li>
<li>Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.</li>
<li>Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.</li>
<li>Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic AI-assisted development experience.</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.</li>
<li>Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: <a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/">https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs</li>
<li>401k with Employer Match</li>
<li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li>
<li>Family Planning Support</li>
<li>Gender-Affirming Care</li>
<li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li>
<li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Generous Paid Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Pay Transparency:</strong></p>
<p>This job posting may span more than one career level.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit <a href="https://www.redditinc.com/careers/">https://www.redditinc.com/careers/</a>.</p>
<p>To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.       <title>Current: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>&nbsp;</h3>
<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.</p>
<h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.</li>
<li>Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.</li>
<li>Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.</li>
<li>Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.</li>
<li>QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.</li>
<li>Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.</li>
<li>Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.</li>
<li>Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.</li>
<li>Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.</li>
<li>Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>Required</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.</li>
<li>Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.</li>
<li>Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.</li>
<li>Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.</li>
<li>A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.</li>
<li>Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.</li>
<li>Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.</li>
<li>Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred</strong></h3>
<ul>

      <title>Clover Health: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<p>Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention &amp; Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.</p>
<p>This is a non-attorney role.&nbsp; You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.</p>
<p><strong>As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention &amp; Investigations, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: </strong>Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.</li>
<li><strong>Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: </strong>Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions.&nbsp; Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Build Defensible Documentation: </strong>Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborate Across Functions: </strong>Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.</li>
<li><strong>Communicate Findings Clearly: </strong>Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Success in this role looks like:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>In your first 90 days</strong>, you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.</li>
<li><strong>By 6 months</strong>, you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.</li>
<li><strong>By 12 months</strong>, you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You should get in touch if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes &amp; investigative experience: </strong>You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care.&nbsp; You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.</li>
<li><strong>You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs:</strong> You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. <em>We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work.</em></li>
<li><strong>Strong communication skills: </strong>You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.</li>
<li>You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.</li>
<li>You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.</li>
<li>You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><strong>Benefits Overview</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Financial Well-Being</strong>: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.</li>
<li><strong>Physical Well-Being</strong>: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.</li>
<li><strong>Mental Well-Being</strong>: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Professional Development</strong>: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Additional Perks:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities</li>
<li>Reimbursement for office setup expenses</li>
<li>Monthly cell phone &amp; internet stipend</li>
<li>Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams</li>
<li>Paid parental leave for all new parents</li>
<li>And much more!</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><strong>About Clover: </strong>We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.</p>
<p>We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.</p>
<p>From Clover’s inception, Diversity &amp; Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.</p>
<hr>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p>

We are an</em><a href="https://e-verify.uscis.gov/esp/media/resourcesContents/E-Verify_Participation_Poster.pdf"><em> </em><em>E-Verify</em></a><em> company.</em></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for the Product Platform team, which owns the foundational layer of our API that all other Lithic products build on top. The team’s mission is to make Lithic's API the best in fintech — reliable, consistent, and a joy to integrate with. This includes API Gateway, Events Platform, API key management and authorization, audit logging, or API norms and versioning strategy.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Write reliable, secure, and scalable code for Lithic's product platform with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Own projects from planning to launch, spanning areas like API key management, reliability, audit logging, or search, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years building production backend systems, ideally including public-facing APIs at scale</li>
<li>Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)</li>
<li>Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity</li>
<li>Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions</li>
<li>Experience with API design fundamentals and product thinking: versioning, backward compatibility, schema-driven development, and weighing tradeoffs from the customer's perspective</li>
<li>Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City, Remote
</p>

<h2>Alloy is where you belong!</h2>
<p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.<br><br>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny">Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>, <a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&amp;sh=55c076453c61">Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>, <a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022">Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.<br><br>Check out our investors and read more about us <a href="https://www.alloy.com/about">here</a>.</p>
<h2>About the team</h2>
<p>We're standing up a new function at Alloy: Forward Deployed Engineering. Our largest enterprise customers need a trusted technical partner with a strong point of view on how Alloy fits into their tech stack and fraud strategy. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be that partner - embedded with our most strategic accounts and owning the technical outcome end-to-end, with each deployment becoming the foundation for the next.</p>
<p>You'll be one of the first two engineers on this founding team. This is a software engineering role through and through - based within our Engineering org, with a scope that spans software, product, and solutions engineering. You won't just join this function - you'll define how it works.</p>
<p>Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.</p>
<h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Architect and tune customer and channel-partner deployments end-to-end — API integrations, third-party data integrations, SDKs, and latency constraints.</li>
<li>Write production code across our stack: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6/React), Python (Django), Node.js, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and AWS.</li>
<li>Serve as Alloy's credible technical voice with customer engineering leadership, making architectural calls in real time.</li>
<li>Own the engineering track of QBRs for your accounts and serve in their on-call escalation path.</li>
<li>Turn your work into reusable platform primitives and docs, so each deployment makes the next one faster.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who we’re looking for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of hands-on experience developing production-ready software, with a proven track record of delivering robust, scalable solutions.</li>
<li>Experience in a customer-facing technical role, Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering with deep technical ownership, or similar - where you were accountable to an external stakeholder, not just an internal roadmap.</li>
<li>Strong backend and API fluency, with the ability to read and write production code across services you don't own.</li>
<li>Sound architectural judgment under ambiguity: you can make and defend technical decisions in the room, with a customer watching.</li>
<li>A genuine pull toward customer-facing work - you find energy in solving a real customer's real problem, alongside their engineers.</li>
<li>A clear technical communicator who can explain a complex integration tradeoff to a bank's VP of Engineering and to an Alloy PM in the same afternoon.</li>
<li>Ability to travel on occasion to our NYC office, as well as client offices in the US.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company with a strong Forward Deployed Engineering culture (Palantir, Scale AI, Ramp, Plaid, Stripe, etc.).</li>
<li>Familiarity with identity, fraud, KYC/KYB, or financial services infrastructure.</li>
<li>Experience with SDK development or embedded front-end integrations.</li>
</ul>
<p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p>
<p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p>
<p><em>This position has a salary range of $141,000 to $250,000.&nbsp;</em></p>
<h2>Benefits and Perks&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy</li>
<li>Employee stock options</li>
<li>Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options</li>
<li>401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation&nbsp;</li>
<li>Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Home office stipend for new employees</li>
<li>Annual Learning &amp; Development annual stipend</li>
<li>Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2>How to apply</h2>
<p>Apply right here! You've found the application!</p>
<p>Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.</p>
<p>All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an <a href="http://alloy.com/">alloy.com</a> email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.</p>

      <title>Airbnb: Operations Engineer, BizTech</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote- USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span>Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span><strong>The Community You Will Join: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect</li>
<li>Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time</li>
<li>Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead</li>
<li>Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows</li>
<li>Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution</li>
</ul>
<p><br><span><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch)</li>
<li>3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS)</li>
<li>Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto)</li>
<li>Experience with Infrastructure as Code</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud</li>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Processing</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Position:</strong> Senior Software Engineer, Processing</p>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> Remote</p>
<p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.</p>
<p>The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services</li>
<li>Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces</li>
<li>Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements</li>
<li>Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way</li>
<li>Participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering</li>
<li>Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments</li>
<li>Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills</li>
<li>Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams</li>
<li>A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills</li>
<li>Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must</li>
<li>An interest in fintech and the payments space is preferred</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>
<p>This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
