      <title>Fivetran : Global Alliance Lead, Capgemini</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Colorado, United States, AMER
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.</p></div><p><span><strong>About Us</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.</span></p>
<p><span>As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>About the role</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The Global Alliance Lead is one of the most strategically important roles in our Ecosystem. You will own our relationship with one of the world's leading technology and transformation partners end-to-end — from C-suite engagement through to practitioner enablement and joint pipeline creation. You will be the architect of how the GSI and NewCo go to market together, ensuring our platform becomes the trusted data foundation inside the GSI’s agentic AI delivery practice globally.</span></p>
<p><span>This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Global Head of GSI Relationships. You will orchestrate across sales, partner solution architecture, marketing, and partner operations — bringing the full weight of the organisation to bear on one of our highest-leverage commercial relationships.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></p>
<p><span><em>Relationship strategy and executive engagement</em></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Own the global GSI relationship at partner and C-suite level, building trusted relationships with Client, practice and delivery team leads.</span></li>
<li><span>Define and execute a multi-year joint strategy that positions dbt + Fivetran as the default open data infrastructure layer within the GSI’s enterprise AI and agentic workflow delivery</span></li>
<li><span>Represent NewCo at GSI’s internal forums, client briefings, and industry events — articulating a compelling narrative around open data infrastructure and its relevance to the GSI’s strategy.&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><em>Platform integration and practitioner adoption</em></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Drive adoption of the dbt + Fivetran platform within GSI delivery teams — ensuring practitioners, solution architects and practice leads are certified, confident, and actively recommending the platform in client engagements</span></li>
<li><span>Work with GSI's practice leadership to embed NewCo's platform into their business groups, standard delivery architectures, RFP responses and client proposals — with particular focus on GSI's Data &amp; AI practices</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><em>Enablement and go-to-market</em></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Design and execute a frictionless enablement programme for GSI practitioners globally — certifications, reference architectures, use case playbooks, and joint delivery assets</span></li>
<li><span>Partner with GSI's marketing and alliances teams to develop joint go-to-market campaigns anchored to open data infrastructure, trusted AI delivery, and closing the gap between AI POC and production</span></li>
<li><span>Support GSI in building and positioning client-facing agentic AI value accelerators — with NewCo platform as the foundational data layer — the "NewCo inside" model</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><em>Pipeline and opportunity development</em></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Source and develop new pipeline opportunities through the GSI relationship — identifying client situations where open data infrastructure creates measurable value.</span></li>
<li><span>Drive co-sell motions alongside GSI account teams, ensuring NewCo is present and influential at the point of client opportunity</span></li>
<li><span>Maintain a rigorous view of GSI-engaged pipeline — tracking opportunity sourcing, progression, and closed business attributed to the alliance</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><em>Telemetry and performance</em></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Define and track the signals that indicate a healthy, high-performing GSI relationship: certifications, sourced opportunities, platform deployments, practitioner engagement, and joint wins</span></li>
<li><span>Report regularly to the Global Head of GSI Relationships on alliance health, pipeline contribution, and strategic progress</span></li>
<li><span>Identify risks and gaps in the relationship early and mobilise internal resources to address them</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>What you will bring</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>15+ years of experience in strategic alliances, enterprise sales, or partner management within the data, cloud, or enterprise software industry</span></li>
<li><span>Demonstrated experience managing complex, global relationships with major consulting firms or global system integrators at a senior level</span></li>
<li><span>Deep understanding of the modern data stack and the business value of open data infrastructure — dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent experience strongly preferred</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and partner level within a global consulting organisation — understanding how GSIs make decisions, build practices, and go to market</span></li>
<li><span>Strong commercial instincts — able to identify, thoroughly qualify and develop joint pipeline opportunities, not just manage existing relationships</span></li>
<li><span>Track record of operating as a cross-functional orchestrator — influencing without direct authority across sales, engineering, marketing, and operations</span></li>
<li><span>Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — able to translate technical platform capabilities into compelling business narratives for consulting and enterprise audiences</span></li>
<li><span>Familiarity with AI, agentic workflows, and the data governance landscape is a strong advantage + strong knowledge of GSI's operating model and contacts within.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Willingness to travel globally to engage GSI leadership and teams across regions</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>What Success Looks Like in Year One</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>A clearly defined joint strategy with GSI signed off at partner Executive level and on track to primary Global Strategic Practice.</span></li>
<li><span>Material increase in GSI practitioner certifications and active platform deployments across Data &amp; AI and Insights &amp; Data practices</span></li>
<li><span>GSI-sourced pipeline contributing measurably to NewCo's revenue</span></li>
<li><span>At least two joint go-to-market campaigns live in the market delivering pipeline — anchored to GSI's agentic AI and trusted data agenda</span></li>
<li><span>First client-facing agentic value accelerators built on NewCo platform delivered with GSI — positioning NewCo as the trusted data infrastructure inside GSI's AI delivery</span></li>
<li><span>A telemetry framework in place tracking alliance health and pipeline influence</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Why This Role</strong></span></p>
<p><span>This is a rare opportunity to own a marquee relationship at a defining moment for both companies. GSI’s are publicly committing to capturing the full value of the agentic AI revolution for customers&nbsp; — and the merged dbt + Fivetran platform is the trusted data infrastructure that makes AI production-ready. The person who builds this alliance well will sit at the intersection of the two most important forces in enterprise technology right now: the scale of a global systems integrator and the open infrastructure that makes AI trustworthy enough to deploy at scale.</span></p>
<p><span>This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.</span></p>
<p><span>#LI-Remote</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. &nbsp;Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.</p></div><div class="title">Denver Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$165,739</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$196,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">OTE (On Target Earning)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$236,774</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$280,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Perks and Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>100% employer-paid medical insurance<strong>*</strong></li>
<li>Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.</li>
<li>RSU stock grants*</li>
<li>Professional development and training opportunities</li>
<li>Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities</li>
<li>Monthly cell phone stipend</li>
<li>Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.</li>
</ul>
<p><em><strong>*</strong>May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information</em></p>
<p><em>Click <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CdawUwjo1Q1B7ghZJ_owdmmHB8VtqhBu?usp=sharing">here</a> to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.</em></p>
<hr>
<p>We’re honored to be <a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/blog/hvr-acquisition-series-d">valued at over $5.6 billion</a>, but more importantly, we’re proud of our&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/culture">core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream</a>. Read about us in&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran-com.s3.amazonaws.com/news/forbes-aug-sept-2022-digital-reprint-10-21-22.pdf">Forbes</a>.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion &amp; belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.</p>
<p>To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xlhtp4dGh8o">click here</a> and enjoy our video.</p>
<p>To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can <a href="https://fivetran.com/candidate-privacy">read our statement here</a>.</p>
<hr>
<p><em>We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this <a href="https://forms.gle/V7k3t4u9j523XkEt6">form</a>. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.</em></p></div>

      <title>Askable: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract) </title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6591/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Australia 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.askablelabs.com/">https://www.askablelabs.com/</a>
</p>

<p>We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.</p>
<p>You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.</p>
<p>Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.</p>
<p><strong>How it works</strong></p>
<ol class="iiilu2 iiil4m iiimkb">
<li><strong>Apply. </strong>Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.</li>
<li><strong>Propose.</strong> Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.</li>
<li><strong>Build.</strong> In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.</li>
<li><strong>Stress-test. </strong>Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.</li>
<li><strong>Model testing.</strong> Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.</li>
<li><strong>Review.</strong> A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.</li>
<li><strong>Next task.</strong> Once your task is accepted, start another.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>2+ years of professional software engineering</li>
<li>Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)</li>
<li>Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++</li>
<li>Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing</li>
<li>Regular use of an AI coding tool</li>
<li>Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models</li>
<li>You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words</li>
<li>At least 10 hours a week, starting now</li>
<li>A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure</li>
<li>Experience building agent tasks or RL environments</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Terms</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you</li>
<li>Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms</li>
<li>The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us</li>
<li>Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork</li>
</ul>
<p>Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Medify: Engineering Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6586/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> London
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.medify.co.uk">http://www.medify.co.uk</a>
</p>

<p>Remote | Full-Time | UK&nbsp;<br><br></p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>At Medify, we’re on a mission to widen access to medicine and healthcare careers through world-class digital learning experiences. Since 2009, we’ve helped thousands of students prepare for high-stakes admissions tests, and we’re continuing to invest in our technology to build innovative, scalable products that support learners around the world.</p>
<p>As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead, mentor and develop our engineering team while remaining hands-on in building the platform that powers Medify.<br><br></p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>As an Engineering Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping both our engineering culture and technical direction. Working closely with the CTO, Product and Design teams, you’ll lead a team of talented full-stack engineers, helping them grow while ensuring we continue to deliver high-quality software that delights our users.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on leadership role, with at least 50% of your time dedicated to engineering. You’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle - from architecture and design through to development, testing and deployment - while driving engineering excellence and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team.</p>
<p>Our current technology stack includes Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, with infrastructure transitioning from Heroku to AWS.<br><br></p>
<p>Key Responsibilities</p>
<ul>
<li>Lead, mentor and support a team of full-stack engineers through coaching, regular 1:1s and performance reviews.</li>
<li>Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.</li>
<li>Support career development, engagement and long-term capability building across the engineering team.</li>
<li>Contribute to hiring by supporting interviews and recruitment of exceptional engineering talent.</li>
<li>Design, develop and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with Product and Design teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.</li>
<li>Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the Medify platform.</li>
<li>Conduct thoughtful code reviews and promote engineering best practices.</li>
<li>Troubleshoot and resolve software issues while maintaining high standards of reliability and performance.</li>
<li>Develop automated tests and contribute to a robust testing culture.</li>
<li>Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement and sprint delivery.</li>
<li>Stay up to date with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve our engineering practices.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>About You</p>
<p>You’ll be a technically strong engineering leader who enjoys developing people just as much as building great software. You’re comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on development and thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.</p>
<p>You’ll ideally have:</p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years’ experience leading or managing software engineering teams.</li>
<li>5+ years’ experience in software development.</li>
<li>Strong experience with modern software engineering practices and frameworks.</li>
<li>Experience with Ruby on Rails and React (highly desirable).</li>
<li>A proven track record of building scalable, maintainable software.</li>
<li>Experience working in Agile development environments.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating with cross-functional Product and Design teams.</li>
<li>Experience recruiting, mentoring and developing engineers.</li>
<li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving ability with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable, but not essential.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Technical Skills</p>
<ul>
<li>Strong knowledge of modern programming languages and software frameworks.</li>
<li>Excellent understanding of software architecture, design principles, data structures and algorithms.</li>
<li>Experience working with relational databases, APIs and networking.</li>
<li>Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and software quality practices.</li>
<li>Familiarity with DevOps tools and deployment pipelines.</li>
<li>Ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.</li>
<li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>✅ What We Offer</p>
<ul>
<li>Fully remote working with flexibility and autonomy.</li>
<li>The opportunity to shape the future of Medify’s technology platform.</li>
<li>A supportive, collaborative engineering culture that values continuous learning.</li>
<li>A hands-on leadership role with real technical influence.</li>
<li>The opportunity to work on products that positively impact thousands of aspiring healthcare professionals every year.</li>
<li>Competitive salary and benefits package.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>How to Apply</p>
<p>If you’re passionate about building exceptional software, developing high-performing engineering teams and making a meaningful impact in education, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>Submit your application along with your CV using the link attached.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medify-engineering-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medify-engineering-manager</a></p>

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

• Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close.

• Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products.

• Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion.

• Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

"},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process.

• You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals.

• You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams.

• You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

• You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

• You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.

","id":"cf13d272-92ac-407d-89bf-7f20d20f7961","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support.

• Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal.

• Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time.

• Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals.

• Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning.

• Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

"},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

• You have 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including experience selling enterprise software, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of closing large, complex enterprise deals and achieving or exceeding revenue targets.

• You are experienced in strategic account planning, building multi-threaded relationships, and navigating long sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

• You have experience selling to technical and executive stakeholders, such as CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform teams, and DevOps leaders.

• You are familiar with software development, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems, and understand how engineering organizations make buying decisions.

• You are comfortable managing procurement processes, security reviews, and legal negotiations for multi-year agreements.

• You can translate technical value into business outcomes and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills, along with a strategic approach to long-term account development.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

"},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

This role is based in New York City or San Francisco.

Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Enterprise team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on organizations with 1,000+ employees, where engineering environments are complex, buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and large deals can take many months to close. Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

  • Build a deep understanding of Spotify’s label, publishing, lyrics, and audiobook contracts, how they’re implemented in our royalty systems, and how they flow into royalty calculations, downstream datasets, and reporting.
  • Use the team’s internal AI tooling to configure contracts in Spotify’s royalty systems and test financial outputs for accuracy before sign-off from Commercial Accounting.
  • Lead data analyses to answer royalty questions from internal teams such as Legal & Licensing and Finance, and from external partners such as rightsholders and back offices.
  • Support month-end royalty close by reviewing checks, validating calculation outputs, and escalating risks or issues.
  • Run month-end analytics, from generating the data and deck to providing commentary on fluxes, to support Content Accounting’s sign-off on final royalty figures.
  • Help build new capabilities for the team, contributing directly to how our internal AI tooling evolves as Spotify’s business grows.
  • Partner closely with Legal & Licensing, Commercial Accounting, Content Accounting, and Financial Engineering.

    ","id":"8251142e-f213-45df-89a9-914e814bd7a7","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Evaluate the commercial and economic viability of new propositions — including new offerings, complementary products, and packaging structures.
  • Build robust business cases end to end, from initial hypothesis through sizing, unit economics, and scenario modelling to an executive-ready recommendation.
  • Partner closely with Finance and Licensing to validate assumptions, pressure-test models, and quantify the financial impact and licensing implications of different propositions.
  • Assess upside, risk, and trade-offs across the portfolio to drive clear prioritization decisions on which opportunities to pursue.
  • Develop a portfolio strategy that balances near- and long-term opportunities and creates more value for Spotify's listeners and business.
  • Build strong relationships across Product and other functions to understand the innovation roadmap and proactively identify commercialization opportunities.
  • Track the competitive and macro landscape to anticipate how proposition and packaging strategy should evolve over time.

    Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.

    These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

    This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

  • Own Projects End to End: Turn what the teams using our platform need into technical designs, drive them through delivery and rollout, and own the results once they're in production.
  • Keep the Platform Healthy: Take part in on-call for critical services, build in observability and quality checks by default, and use automation, including AI tooling, to reduce toil for the team and our users.

We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job.

    The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next.

    We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

  • Lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 graphic designers, motion designers, and producers, supporting their creative growth and career development.

  • Shape the visual and motion design direction across Reverb projects, creating distinctive work that brings Spotify's brand and stories to life.

  • Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

  • Guide creative development from concept through delivery, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and thoughtful design decisions.

  • Manage project intake, priorities, budgets, timelines, and resources to help the team deliver meaningful work across multiple projects.

  • Collaborate with Reverb's creative and production leads to build a connected, effective studio and a consistent creative experience.

  • Present creative concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders, explaining the thinking behind decisions and building alignment.

  • Work with internal teams and external creative partners to maintain design quality, manage production needs, and navigate relevant legal and licensing requirements.

  • You're comfortable shaping creative direction across digital, social, advertising, editorial, and long-form brand content, adapting your approach to different audiences and formats.

  • You have experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and relevant visual or motion design tools, and you're curious about how emerging technologies can support the creative process.

  • Build and transform the function. Set Spotify’s global measurement and effectiveness vision across brand, performance, and full-funnel advertising, and fundamentally build and elevate our capabilities to get there.
  • Advance measurement science. Lead our approach to incrementality, causal inference, experimentation, attribution, marketing mix modeling, and brand lift, and set rigorous standards for how we measure advertiser outcomes.
  • Define what we need to prove. Set the scientific requirements for measuring advertising impact on Spotify, and influence investment priorities with Product, Engineering, and Data Science, who own building the solutions.
  • Turn evidence into advertiser growth. Build marketing science and consulting capabilities that help advertisers understand and improve their results on Spotify, and partner with commercial leaders to turn that evidence into deeper relationships and smarter investment decisions.
  • Tailor measurement by industry. Develop approaches that reflect the distinct goals and challenges of advertisers in key verticals.
  • Build research and partnerships. Set an ambitious research agenda, develop relationships with leading measurement and technology partners, and advance independent validation and new approaches.
  • Lead what’s next. Anticipate how AI, new methods, and ecosystem shifts will change measurement, and position Spotify to lead rather than follow.
  • Shape industry thinking. Go beyond representing Spotify to help shape how the industry approaches effectiveness and measurement standards, through direct engagement with CMOs and agency leaders, seats on industry boards, major conference stages, and thought leadership.
  • Build an exceptional organization. Design, scale, and lead a high-performing global team spanning measurement strategy, marketing science, advertiser consulting, research, and partnerships.
  • Shape Advertising leadership decisions. Bring scientific expertise, advertiser insight, and an evidence-based perspective to the leadership team’s strategic choices and long-term priorities.

  • Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation.

  • Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas.
  • Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures.
  • Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.

    We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

    • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
    • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
    • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
    • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

    Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

    ","id":"0eebb462-b5a2-4e3a-b830-d8ef7505b014","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
    Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
     
    Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
     
    Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
     
    Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
     
    You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
  • You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
  • You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
  • You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
  • You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
  • You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
  • You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
  • You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

    • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
    • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community.     • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

    Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities.

    As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

     

    ","id":"1ee5dcb7-a5fe-465b-91da-d42ebab374c8","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

  • Build and improve agentic AI workflows that turn security vulnerability findings into tested, review-ready code changes for engineering teams across Spotify.

  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure the quality of automated fixes, including correctness, completeness, safety, build and test success, and pull request merge rates.

  • Develop tools and processes to compare remediation approaches, evaluate AI models, and continuously improve the reliability and effectiveness of generated fixes.

  • Research and apply emerging practices in AI-assisted vulnerability remediation, including prompt engineering, context engineering, and vulnerability-specific fix guidance.

  • Identify which vulnerability types are suitable for automated remediation, balancing security impact, technical feasibility, and developer experience.

  • Collaborate with developers and security stakeholders to collect feedback through code reviews, pull requests, support channels, and interactive sessions, using these insights to improve remediation quality.

  • Help shape how Spotify approaches security posture management by building scalable solutions that reduce security risks and make it easier for teams to address vulnerabilities.

    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

  • You have experience in software engineering, particularly within security engineering, developer experience, or internal infrastructure.

  • You can confidently read, understand, and write code in one or more languages such as Java, Python, Scala, C++, or TypeScript.

  • You have experience designing and building scalable systems, with an understanding of software architecture and reliable engineering practices.

  • You have worked with agentic AI systems or AI-assisted development workflows and understand how to apply them to real-world engineering challenges.

  • You understand common security risks, attack vectors, and vulnerabilities, including those affecting AI and machine learning systems, and approaches to mitigating them.

  • You have experience integrating security tools or automated workflows into production engineering environments.

  • You are familiar with agentic AI frameworks and approaches to evaluating the quality, reliability, and safety of AI-generated outputs.

  • You enjoy collaborating across teams, learning from feedback, and navigating ambiguity. You're comfortable experimenting with new approaches while balancing innovation with thoughtful security decisions.

    • "},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

  • This role is based in Toronto

    The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

    We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

    Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.

    Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.

    Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.

    Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

    For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

  • Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engage with generative AI music.
  • Design and run large-scale analyses and evaluations of generative music systems, from prompt interpretation to model output quality, using Spotify's unique behavioral datasets, annotations, and experimentation platforms.
  • Partner with Engineers and AI Researchers to integrate evaluation signals into model development loops, debugging workflows, and product iteration, making sure scientific rigor informs technical direction.
  • Identify the behavioral and market dynamics that shape sustainable consumer demand and creator participation, and translate them into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Build practical, scalable metrics and decision systems that define what "good" looks like for AI music: credibility, user delight, safety, creator alignment, and ecosystem trust.
  • Bring together model, user behavior, and ecosystem signals into clear narratives that shape product strategy, cross-functional alignment, and long-term priorities across Spotify.
  • Create the datasets, dashboards, and long-term measurement systems that give Spotify a lasting, comprehensive understanding of product health and impact.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, Research, Legal, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Policy, and Licensing teams, bringing statistical rigor and principled measurement to help build artist-first systems that scale responsibly.

  • You have a track record of using insights to shape strategy for major company initiatives involving many different partners.

  • You're proficient in advanced analytics with Python and SQL, have analyzed large datasets, and use AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot) to increase your productivity and impact.
  • You have experience developing metrics frameworks for complex products that help teams measure impact and reason clearly about priorities.
  • You have experience with machine learning frameworks, designing and assessing multimodal or embedding-based models, and validating them against LLM judges or human ground truth, with an understanding of how to evaluate models beyond offline accuracy.
  • You have a solid grounding in experimental design and causal inference, such as A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and power analysis.
  • You thrive when tackling loosely defined problems in ambiguous, zero-to-one spaces.

    We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.

    You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale.     ","id":"9d1c90b5-a8a4-4218-b2f3-7bbaefae7fd1","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.
  • Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.
  • Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.
  • Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.
  • Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.
  • Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.
  • Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.
  • Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.
  • Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.

    Spotify is shaping the future of advertising by connecting brands with fans through audio, video, and experiences that are part of people's everyday lives. As our advertising business grows, we're focused on bringing innovative products to market, helping advertisers succeed, and turning new ideas into meaningful business growth.

    We're looking for a Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing to lead the next chapter of our global Advertising Product Marketing team. Reporting to the Head of Advertising Business Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to shape product strategy, strengthen our market position, and help advertisers get more value from Spotify.

    This is an opportunity to build and lead a product marketing function with a clear voice in product decisions and a direct impact on business growth. You'll bring customer insights into product development, establish a disciplined approach to go-to-market execution and product adoption, create compelling reasons for advertisers to choose Spotify, and help a global team deliver measurable results.

    ","id":"b9533f31-7bff-43f6-aaf0-60003f017d88","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for global Advertising Product Marketing, connecting advertiser needs, product innovation, competitive insights, and business growth.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to bring customer and market insights into product decisions and turn innovation into solutions advertisers value.
  • Lead global go-to-market strategies for Spotify's advertising products, including brand and performance advertising, self-service, programmatic, and emerging solutions. Own product positioning, messaging, packaging, launches, and adoption.
  • Build a deeper understanding of advertisers, agencies, buying behaviors, and the competitive landscape. Use these insights to identify opportunities, influence product priorities, and strengthen Spotify's position in the market.
  • Drive product adoption and commercial growth by identifying customer needs, addressing barriers to adoption, and partnering with teams to improve product usage, retention, and revenue. Define clear measures of success and use results to guide future decisions.
  • Turn complex advertising technology, data, and measurement capabilities into clear, differentiated customer value propositions tied to measurable business outcomes. Partner with Business Marketing to create a consistent story across products and help advertisers understand the impact Spotify can deliver.
  • Strengthen how products move from development to market. Establish clear processes, shared accountability, and measures of readiness that help teams make informed decisions about when to launch, scale, improve, or stop initiatives.
  • Equip Sales and regional teams with the insights, messaging, and tools they need to bring Spotify's advertising solutions to customers. 
  • Work with Measurement and Advertising Effectiveness teams to connect product capabilities with credible evidence of advertiser outcomes, and feed that evidence back into product decisions
  • Explore how AI, automation, and emerging advertising technologies can improve our products, customer experiences, and product marketing practices and identify opportunities to rethink how Spotify develops, positions, and scales its advertising solutions.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing global Product Marketing organization, attracting outstanding talent, strengthening strategic and commercial capabilities, and creating a culture of creativity, accountability, collaboration, and measurable impact.

    ","id":"ee45924c-894c-4ea0-9c93-c5221894063f","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for session management across Spotify’s clients, device types, and strategic partner integrations.
  • Use research, data, and feedback from users and developers to identify access friction and prioritize improvements with the greatest potential impact.
  • Improve how sessions are established, maintained, and ended, balancing reliable access with account protection, privacy, and user control.
  • Shape device connection, session transfer, and partner authorization experiences, including clear consent when an app requests access or additional capabilities.

  • Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
  • Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
  • Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
  • Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
  • Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
  • Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
  • Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

    Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. Our team builds and operates the authorization and permissioning systems that enable creators and their teams to securely access and manage their presence across Spotify. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks.

    This is a backend-focused role working on systems that sit on a critical path for Spotify's creator ecosystem. You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

    ","id":"e04833c0-9cff-4b5e-b217-91a3bcb57051","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do:","content":"

  • Design, build, deploy, and operate scalable backend services that power authorization, permissions, and team management across Spotify.

  • Take ownership of critical systems that enable creators, teams, agents, licensors, and other partners to securely access and manage the right content and capabilities.

  • Evolve our backend architecture to support continued growth in users, use cases, and Spotify products while maintaining high standards for reliability, performance, and security.

  • Define the technical direction for policy enforcement infrastructure

The UK attracted €14 billion in startup funding in H1 2026, yet access to later-stage capital, customers, talent and infrastructure remains a challenge.

In my follow-up feature, I spoke to founders and ecosystem leaders about what needs to change, from closing regional and gender funding gaps to helping companies commercialise and compete globally.
